historical_claims.anchor: A girl named Celie begins writing letters because there is almost no one she is allowed to speak to.
She finds letters from Nettie hidden in Mister's belongings.
They are Celie's children, the babies taken from her years before.
The man Celie and Nettie believed was their father, Alphonso, is actually their stepfather.
At last Nettie arrives in Georgia with Samuel, Adam, Olivia, and Tashi.

description: Retells The Color Purple through Celie and Nettie’s separation, Sofia’s defiance, Shug Avery’s arrival, hidden letters, and the relationships that transform Celie’s life.
